selection.primary: Date-equal high/low/range MAE, equally averaged over two and five days

frozen_parts: Encoder, input embedding, quantization projection, binary codebook and coarse-only projection; verify bit-identical encoded tokens
targets: Actual unclipped future OHLCVA on known prefixes; normalization statistics remain history-only. Clipping of encoder input remains at plus/minus five.
checkpoint_rule: Save every epoch; select minimum reconstruction primary among epochs passing all frozen guards; retain unguarded best for diagnostic rejection analysis
prediction_gate: Always evaluate the already selected fixed decoder and all three existing predictors. No checkpoint or sampler reselection.
interpretation: Fixed-weight temporal transfer; 2023 H2 was used by earlier sampling research. Not an untouched test. Official tokenizer pretraining coverage remains unresolved.
scope: Decoder-only adaptation first; no encoder/codebook change or post-generation price repair. Further representation changes require a separate controlled experiment.

confirmation.five_day: Secondary horizon, assessed with same descriptive conditions
confirmation.promotion: Research evidence only; no daily model replacement

sensitivity: Identical legal generated-token trajectories, at least 16 shared paths; secondary and no selection
